title: Cost and scope
requirement: Mandatory API/data spend is $0; preserve Cape/Kennedy-to-Maryland use case, existing hardware and free local deployment; no purchases, paid fallback or automatic upgrade.

title: Location
requirement: US ZIP representative point confirmation; optional GPS/manual fallback, coordinates, local IANA timezone; preserve leading zero; up to 100 active locations; fixture-zip is a fixture only.

title: Schedule
requirement: LL2 production v2.3.0; normalize identifiers, pad, variant, precision, window, status and timestamps; exact/window/date/unknown remain distinct; no fabricated liftoff.

title: Evidence
requirement: Exact mission/pad/attempt association; typed evidence and versioned route registry; deterministic approved parsers; hazard-only screening has no timed/elevation forecast; unknown branches/doglegs fail closed.

title: Profiles and reuse
requirement: Inspect and reuse suitable open source; pin historical snapshots, licenses, hashes and metadata including variant/class/recovery/stage/datum/downrange/time origin and powered intervals. Incompatible/unknown metadata cannot enter production.

title: Geometry
requirement: WGS84 ECEF/ENU, true azimuth, geometric elevation/range/occultation; 5 s samples, gaps <=15 s, >=20 s luminous visibility; only first ascent burns; no booster return, passive drift, refraction or full simulator.

title: Ensemble
requirement: Preserve correlated candidate tracks, union of windows, maximum elevation range, circular sectors and movement; round times outward to minute and bearings outward to 15 degrees; disclose disagreement and uncertainty.

title: Astronomy/time
requirement: Observer-local date and offset across DST; numeric solar elevation, Earth shadow, active emission; DE421 pinned/range checked; sunrise -0.833 degrees, twilight -6/-12/-18; no-rise/no-set null; daylight is explanatory.

title: Weather
requirement: NWS observer point/grid skyCover with intervals and issue/fetch times; percent/meters; worst overlapping bin or qualifying continuous subinterval; exact clear/mixed/poor/fresh thresholds; missing clouds unavailable, missing visibility disclosed.

title: Advice
requirement: Deterministic visibility_rules_v1_1 order, four advice labels, reconstruction <=Possible; official observer-region/time evidence required for Worth a look; no percentage probability, model-dependent negatives.

title: Uncertainty/revisions
requirement: Evaluate window alternatives and refine changing outcomes; invalidate on time/liftoff/location/route/weather/rules changes; stale essential data blocks combined positive advice and new positive notices.

title: Free notices
requirement: In-app history and downloadable ICS snapshots; precise-target T-24h/T-30m, conditional window planning; default Worth a look, Possible opt-in; quiet 22:00-07:00 with explicit override; no past milestones.

title: Notice transitions
requirement: Revision cancel/recompute; >=300 s shift, local-date change, scrub or persistent downgrade correct prior notices; 10 min coalesce except inside T-30 or scrub; transactional uniqueness and consent/status recheck, retries and expiry.

title: Privacy/security
requirement: Selected subscription location only; optional exact GPS; immediate unsubscribe, deletion <=24h; 30-day redacted logs, protected admin, audit actions, server secrets, HTTPS.

title: Ingestion budgets
requirement: Shared LL2 30m/5m polls with 12 requests rolling hour including pages/retries; route 6h/1h where permitted; NWS daily points and hourly/15m distinct-cell grids with backoff; no per-user schedule polling.

title: Backend and operations
requirement: Next.js/FastAPI/worker/PostgreSQL Compose, versioned evidence/templates locally; jobs/outbox/cache, health, daily off-host backup/recovery; no mandatory Redis/Kubernetes.

title: UI
requirement: Responsive accessible location/list/detail/sky-band/conditions/sources/subscriptions/notices/admin journeys; state distinctions, local dates, sunrise changes and source-supported precision.

title: Reproducibility
requirement: Record source URLs/hashes/licenses, coordinates, UTC, parser/astronomy/rules versions and reasons; independent geometry <=0.1 degree and sunrise/sunset <=120 s; every story has regression evidence.

title: Engineering gate
requirement: Initial three-day investigation: historical Cape/Maryland case FIRST, held-out profile, independent route, near-pad comparison, then upcoming mission attempt; failure report is not a passed real-data gate; continue whole build.

title: Release and performance
requirement: Real Cape fixture, compatible profile family, independent mission route, separate official-guidance fixture; all stories and failure modes; 100 locations x two-stage 15m full candidate set; cached p95 <2 s and no budget overrun.

title: Empirical pilot
requirement: Archive prospective forecasts and forecast-time weather before launch; collect >=5 launches and >=30 labeled attempts, clouds and unsuccessful/inconclusive outcomes; publish denominators/false positives/missed sightings; absence of sighting !=negative.

title: Email
requirement: Only already available verified no-additional-cost email, explicit consent/verified address and provider-specific idempotency/reconciliation tests; disabled by default.

title: Research improvements
requirement: Multiple representative profiles beyond initial one, modern video OCR and licensed ISSC exports; optional layers can downgrade, never improve worse baseline; not required dependencies.

title: Non-goals
requirement: No Flight Club, paid feeds, full flight simulator, orbital passes/reentry, terrain/building obstruction, 3D cloud transfer, live dot, SMS/required push, guaranteed email, calibrated probabilities or arbitrary map interpretation.
